VI.description: Replaces the key state of the CALLING thread through user32.dll SetKeyboardState (stdcall\2C called in LabVIEW's UI thread). Only that thread's state changes - not the physical keyboard\2C not GetAsyncKeyState\2C not any other program. Running in the UI thread\2C this sets what LabVIEW's panels read for the modifier keys\2C until the thread next retrieves real input from the host's keyboard or mouse. key state is cut or padded with zeros to the 256 bytes the function reads. return value is the Win32 BOOL\3A non-zero on success\2C 0 on failure. When error in carries an error the DLL is not called. Generated by scripts\5CBuild Win32 Wrappers.vi - do not edit by hand\2C rebuild it.

Control.description: 256 bytes indexed by virtual-key code\3B bit 0x80 = down. Read it with user32 GetKeyboardState.vi and change only the keys you mean.
When this carries an error the DLL is not called and the error is passed to error out.

Indicator.description: error in\2C or the Call Library Function Node's own error.
